summary.zh: 指令输入框左边住着一只 1-bit 像素幽灵猫：眼睛跟着指针转，按下会被压扁，聚焦后输入框弹开、出现光标；你半天不打字，它就在格子里来回踱步，一打字就停下来看着光标。
summary.en: A 1-bit pixel ghost cat lives in the command bar’s icon slot: its eyes follow your pointer, it squishes when you press, the bar springs open on focus; leave it idle and the cat paces back and forth, start typing and it stops to watch the caret.

technique.zh: 精灵帧是离散的：canvas 逐像素画、image-rendering: pixelated，从不补间；位置是连续的：弹簧驱动的亚像素 translate。眼睛按指针方向分 8 个方位换像素位置。输入框宽度、猫的位移、Esc 回中都是同一个弹簧。
technique.en: Sprite frames are discrete: drawn pixel by pixel on canvas with image-rendering: pixelated, never tweened. Position is continuous: a spring-driven sub-pixel translate. Eyes snap to one of 8 directions toward the pointer. The bar width, the cat’s travel and the Esc recentre all share one spring.

desc.zh: 聚焦后多久没打字就开始踱步

adapt.zh: 放在搜索框、⌘K 面板、AI 输入框里。猫的像素图在 script.js 顶部，可以换成自己的吉祥物。
adapt.en: Drop it into a search bar, ⌘K palette or AI prompt box. The pixel art lives at the top of script.js; swap in your own mascot.
